program.name: Archer Project
program.subject: Climber / pull strength
program.blurb: A long project toward one-arm pulling: archer pull-ups, wide grips, slow negatives and lock-offs.
program.about: A project toward one-arm pulling, step by step over sixty days. Heavy days use archer pull-ups, wide-grip pull-ups, slow negatives and lock-offs in short straight sets with full rest. The other day pairs pulls with pushes, so the shoulders stay balanced. Abs finish every session. Both later levels move to harder versions rather than more reps.
